explanation: The body-parsing intercepts match any HTTP method on the shared /post-only URL. A request fired by the sibling test (a GET with no content-type header) can arrive after its test ended and is matched against the next test's still-registered route, so the handler sees content-type undefined. The proxy matches incoming requests only by URL and method against whichever routes are registered, with no marker of which test they came from.
fix: Scope the three body-parsing intercepts to POST ({ method: 'POST', url: '/post-only' }) so a leaked GET can no longer match.
